title: Consultant Services, NYCEDC Asset Management Building Plans and Document Management Platform RFEI
agency_path: City of New York > Economic Development Corporation
submit_to: 1 Liberty Plaza, 12th Floor, New York, NY 10006
description_text:
New York City Economic Development Corporation (NYCEDC) seeks expressions of interest from qualified respondents on solutions to modernize how NYCEDC manages building plans, drawings, engineering documents, studies, reports, models, and related property records. NYCEDCs immediate challenge is that critical asset documentation is fragmented across legacy systems, network drives, Microsoft SharePoint sites, project repositories, and other platforms. This fragmentation makes it difficult to identify the official record, locate complete drawing sets, manage versions, collaborate with stakeholders, and avoid duplicative studies or rework. NYCEDC is seeking a centralized, governed platform that improves access, search, collaboration, metadata quality, records management, security, and long-term stewardship. The solution should also establish a scalable data foundation for future capabilities, including digital twins, virtual tours, geospatial navigation, predictive asset maintenance, scenario modeling, and portfolio-level analytics.

It is the policy of NYCEDC to comply with all federal, state and City laws and regulations which prohibit unlawful discrimination because of race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status and other protected category and to take affirmative action in working with contracting parties to ensure certified Minority and Women-owned Business Enterprises (MWBEs) share in the economic opportunities generated by NYCEDCs projects and initiatives.

Companies who have been certified with the New York City Department of Small Business Services as Minority and Women Owned Business Enterprises (M/WBE) are strongly encouraged to apply. To learn more about M/WBE certification, NYCEDCs M/WBE program, and programs to assist M/WBE in navigating current and upcoming opportunities on NYCEDC projects, please visit https://sbsconnect.nyc.gov/certification-directory-search/ and edc.nyc/opportunity-mwdbe.

Respondents may submit questions and/or request clarifications from NYCEDC by directing such questions and/or clarification requests to the Q&A webform available at https://edc.nyc/rfps. Answers to all questions will be posted by October 2, 2026 to https://edc.nyc/rfps. Questions regarding the subject matter of this RFEI will not be accepted after 5PM ET on Wednesday, September 30, 2026; however, technical questions pertaining to downloading and submitting responses to this RFEI may be directed to RFPREQUEST@nyc.edc on or before Tuesday, October 6, 2026 at 4PM ET.

Detailed submission guidelines and requirements are outlined in the RFEI, available as of Tuesday, September 22, 2026. To download a copy of the solicitation documents please visit https://edc.nyc/rfps. RESPONSES ARE DUE NO LATER THAN 4PM ON Tuesday, October 6, 2026. Please click the link in the Submission Guidelines section of this projects webpage (which can be found on https://edc.nyc/rfps) to electronically upload a response to this solicitation. Please upload your response as a .zip file with your company name and the title of this project.
